description: HELD preparation: project-level emitted LB log entries only; armor_deny nonstorm. No URL/ID labels; resource labels inherited. Sampling/coverage calibration required.
filter: (((resource.type = "http_load_balancer" AND resource.labels.project_id = "based-hardware" AND logName = "projects/based-hardware/logs/requests") AND (jsonPayload.enforcedSecurityPolicy.outcome =~ "^DENY$" OR jsonPayload.enforcedEdgeSecurityPolicy.outcome =~ "^DENY$" OR jsonPayload.statusDetails =~ "^(denied_by_security_policy|body_denied_by_security_policy)$")) AND NOT ((httpRequest.requestMethod =~ "^GET$" AND httpRequest.status = 429 AND httpRequest.requestUrl =~ "^https://api[.]omi[.]me/v2/sync-local-files/[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}(?:[?][^#]*)?$")))
